captures.description: THE DATABASE, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'The Global Nonviolent Action Database is a free online project hosted by Swarthmore College that catalogues more than 1,200 nonviolent campaign case studies from over 100 countries.' Scope and timeline; clusters; waves; search; origin (2011). Six cards: the database (two), CNCR, Discuss Data, Policy Commons, Swarthmore.
